deviations.note: First runner observation of the unchanged lanes on PR #58 (draft, szTheory/accrue) and the in-scope follow-ups. Pushes: 5a2b1aa3d (first observation), 03e8053e3, d7ef3edab, 26e500c37, d4dc2877f, fb859cacd. Every run is attempt 1 of its own commit; none was rerun. Entries are grouped by workflow/job/step/path with observed_in listing every attempt-1 run that showed the red. Three reds remain open and go to checkpoint 254-03-03: the SL-A PR-claims contract (.planning/WINDOWS.md open_count), the Phase 200 Storybook a11y spec in both owner jobs, and the intermittent Phase 199 action-menu spec in browser-uat. The budget top-level manifest_sha256 still names the pre-254-03 storybook/phase252-manifest.json (router.ex and subscription_manifest.ex digests were refreshed in c2e5af2d3 and 9fae369b0); the 254-09-02 restamp re-points it.
